title: Pin lazy-root ordinary admission behavior when the rebind status process never starts
outcome: A lazy settled root's first admission during a certified never-started session_status failure has an explicit documented availability contract and discriminating coverage without weakening uncertain-grant or local durability boundaries.
acceptance: Record the intended eligibility of fresh NotStarted session_status control-process failures for ordinary local root admission after lazy boot, distinguishing uncertain grants and restored causes.
Add a regression through lazy boot and first admission that pins the chosen status-read failure behavior while preserving strict uncertainty and local write controls.
